coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping soundly after a late night-owl bedtime
Waking slowly and completing a daily stretching routine beside the bed
Showering, washing, and grooming for the workday
Preparing and eating a breakfast that respects the medical dietary restriction, with strong coffee
Dressing in professional work clothes and packing the work bag
Drive the EV to the clinic for the day's appointments
Conducting in-person clinical psychology assessment and therapy sessions with clients
Taking a lunch break and eating a restriction-appropriate meal nearby
Running afternoon clinical sessions and remote telehealth consultations from the office
Stepping away briefly for a strong coffee and mental reset
Finishing case notes, treatment planning, and administrative documentation
Drive the EV back home through evening traffic
Washing up and changing into comfortable casual clothes (finishing before Member 1 uses the bathroom at 18:15)
Cooking a from-scratch dinner that fits the medical dietary restriction; Member 1 helps finish cooking and eats dinner together from 18:30
Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher, and wiping down the counters together with Member 1
Relaxing and doing a stretching session with Member 1 (watching YouTube videos while stretching)
Studying cognitive psychology material on the computer with the desk lamp on, alongside Member 1 who is using the computer for personal tasks
Quiet devotional reading, reflection, and prayer
Streaming a television show to unwind before bed
Nightly wash-up, skincare, and oral care routine
Tidying the room, laying out tomorrow's clothes, and dimming the lights
Falling asleep to end the day
